<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="58001006" href="/ko/%EB%9D%BC%EC%9D%B4%EB%B8%8C%EB%9F%AC%EB%A6%AC/%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC%EC%9A%A9-%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%B1%85%EB%AA%85/%ED%9E%88%EB%B8%8C%EB%A6%AC%EC%84%9C/1/#v58001006" target="_blank">히브리서 1:6</a>)</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1. </span>주의 임명된 왕</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz">맏아들 찬양하라.</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp">공의로 다스려서</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sz">축복 넘치게 하리.</p>
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 sp">주 이름 사랑하는,</p>
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 sz">위엄 지닌 예수,</p>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sp">여호와 입증하고</p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sz">그 주권 알리리.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 se">(후렴)</p>
<p id="p13" data-pid="13" class="p13 sp">여호와가 세운</p>
<p id="p14" data-pid="14" class="p14 sz">맏아들 찬양하라!</p>
<p id="p15" data-pid="15" class="p15 sp">왕으로 즉위하여</p>
<p id="p16" data-pid="16" class="p16 sz">지금 다스린다네!</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p17" data-pid="17" class="p17 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">2. </span>우리 대속주인</p>
<p id="p18" data-pid="18" class="p18 sz">맏아들 찬양하라.</p>
<p id="p19" data-pid="19" class="p19 sp">겸손히 자신 바쳐</p>
<p id="p20" data-pid="20" class="p20 sz">죄 용서받게 했네.</p>
<p id="p21" data-pid="21" class="p21 sp">흰옷으로 단장한</p>
<p id="p22" data-pid="22" class="p22 sz">신부 예비됐네.</p>
<p id="p23" data-pid="23" class="p23 sp">그 결혼은 주 주권</p>
<p id="p24" data-pid="24" class="p24 sz">정당함 알리리.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p25" data-pid="25" class="p25 se">(후렴)</p>
<p id="p26" data-pid="26" class="p26 sp">여호와가 세운</p>
<p id="p27" data-pid="27" class="p27 sz">맏아들 찬양하라!</p>
<p id="p28" data-pid="28" class="p28 sp">왕으로 즉위하여</p>
<p id="p29" data-pid="29" class="p29 sz">지금 다스린다네!</p>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="closingContent">
